task: Eight caching-related git/http doc sources were added to this repo: `souin` (darkweak/souin, sparse docs/website/content), `caddy-cache-handler` (caddyserver/cache-handler, whole-repo), `squid` (squid-cache/squid-cache.github.io, sparse docs - the whole Squid wiki), `varnish` (www.varnish.org sitemap scrape scoped to docs/{tutorials,users-guide,reference,install-guide}, /tags/ excluded), `nginx` (nginx.org sitemap scrape of /en/docs/ - sitemap locs are http:// for the https site, urlToPath has a same-host pathname fallback for this), `apache-traffic-server` (explicit urls: cache-basics, hierarchical-caching, storage + cache.config/hosting.config/volume.config/storage.config/records.yaml + cache logging/stats), `http-caching-rfcs` (RFC 9110/9111/5861/8246/9211/9213), `http-caching-tutorial` (mnot cache_docs single page). All tagged in source-tags.ts (new `caching` tag, label 'HTTP caching'). src/commands/build-index.ts was extended for TOML (+++) frontmatter and src/ingestors/HttpIngestor.ts urlToPath gained a scheme-mismatch same-host pathname fallback. The full verification battery must pass. If any sensor fails, fix the underlying source code or test - NEVER weaken, delete, or skip a test, NEVER loosen a sensor, NEVER touch git refs. CI parity: tools-sync mirrors the 'Verify tools.sh is in sync' CI step (fix: pnpm generate:tools). fetch-verify does real fetches (DOCS_ONLY) into /tmp and asserts page counts, paths, and index titles - failures usually mean wrong sparse paths/rootPath/urlPattern, broken TOML parsing in build-index.ts, or a regression in the urlToPath fallback.

sensors.name: lint
sensors.hint: tsc --noEmit type errors - fix the TypeScript, do not suppress.

sensors.name: tools-sync
sensors.hint: commands/tools.sh is auto-generated from src/commands/tools-template.ts. Run `pnpm generate:tools` and commit the regenerated file - never edit tools.sh directly.

sensors.name: unit
sensors.hint: Vitest unit failures - read the failing assertion, fix the source, never the test's expectations (unless the test itself encodes the old wrong behaviour AND the task says behaviour changed).

sensors.name: sources-present
sensors.cmd: for s in souin caddy-cache-handler squid varnish nginx apache-traffic-server http-caching-rfcs http-caching-tutorial; do rg -q "name: \"$s\"" src/application/sources.ts || { echo "MISSING source: $s"; exit 1; }; done && for s in souin caddy-cache-handler squid varnish nginx apache-traffic-server http-caching-rfcs http-caching-tutorial; do rg -q "\"$s\":" src/application/source-tags.ts || rg -q "^  $s:" src/application/source-tags.ts || { echo "MISSING tag: $s"; exit 1; }; done && rg -q 'caching:' src/application/source-tags.ts
sensors.hint: The eight new DocSource entries and their SOURCE_TAGS + TAG_LABELS wiring must exist. Restore them if a previous iteration clobbered them.

sensors.name: fetch-verify
sensors.cmd: rm -rf /tmp/loop-docs-verify && DOCS_ONLY=souin,caddy-cache-handler,squid,varnish,nginx,apache-traffic-server,http-caching-rfcs,http-caching-tutorial DOCS_OUT_DIR=/tmp/loop-docs-verify DOCS_MAX_AGE=0 pnpm fetch-docs >/dev/null 2>&1 && test "$(ls -R /tmp/loop-docs-verify/souin | grep -c '\.md$')" -ge 36 && test -f /tmp/loop-docs-verify/caddy-cache-handler/README.md && test "$(ls -R /tmp/loop-docs-verify/squid | grep -c '\.md$')" -ge 400 && test "$(ls -R /tmp/loop-docs-verify/varnish | grep -c '\.md$')" -ge 100 && test "$(ls -R /tmp/loop-docs-verify/nginx | grep -c '\.md$')" -ge 140 && test "$(ls -R /tmp/loop-docs-verify/apache-traffic-server | grep -c '\.md$')" -ge 10 && test "$(ls -R /tmp/loop-docs-verify/http-caching-rfcs | grep -c '\.md$')" -ge 6 && test -f /tmp/loop-docs-verify/http-caching-tutorial/index.md && ! ls /tmp/loop-docs-verify/nginx | rg -q '^http:' && ! ls -R /tmp/loop-docs-verify/varnish | rg -q 'tags' && node --import tsx/esm src/commands/build-index.ts /tmp/loop-docs-verify | awk -F'\t' '$1=="souin/docs/middlewares/caddy.md" && $2=="Caddy" {found=1} END{exit !found}' && node --import tsx/esm src/commands/build-index.ts /tmp/loop-docs-verify | awk -F'\t' '$1=="souin/docs/configuration.md" && $2=="Configuration" {found=1} END{exit !found}' && test -f /tmp/loop-docs-verify/nginx/en/docs/http/ngx_http_proxy_module.md && jq -e '.caching.sources | contains(["souin","caddy-cache-handler","squid","varnish","nginx","apache-traffic-server","http-caching-rfcs","http-caching-tutorial"])' /tmp/loop-docs-verify/_source_groups.json >/dev/null
sensors.hint: End-to-end: real fetch of all eight caching sources. Asserts: souin >=36 md (TOML titles index correctly: middlewares/caddy.md -> 'Caddy'), cache-handler README, squid >=400 md, varnish >=100 md with no tags/ listing pages, nginx >=140 md with clean en/docs/... paths (no literal 'http:' dir - that means the urlToPath scheme-mismatch fallback regressed), ATS >=10 md, RFCs >=6 md, mnot tutorial index.md, and the caching group contains all eight. Check sparse paths/rootPath/urlPattern on the DocSource entries and urlToPath in HttpIngestor.ts.

sensors.name: e2e
sensors.hint: Docker-based E2E (3-min timeout). It wipes ./docs at setup AND teardown - that is expected. Read the failing vitest output; if the Docker build itself fails, check the Dockerfile stages. Do not skip the test to make it green.
